datasets.dataset_name: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API — Cairo sample
transformations: zip hourly arrays into one event per timestamp
rename measurements to VerdaTrace canonical semantics
limitations: Point sample is not representative of all Cairo microclimates.
Historical values inherit the limitations of the upstream reanalysis/weather models.
datasets.commit_policy: A bounded attributed sample may be committed.

datasets.license: CC0: Public Domain (as displayed by Kaggle metadata)
datasets.temporal_coverage: 2020 epoch timestamps; exact bounds determined after retrieval
transformations: preserve reported CO/LPG/smoke values and source units
limitations: Kaggle retrieval may require a Kaggle account/API token.
Locations and sensor calibration specifications are not provided.
The 61.93 MB source file is intentionally not committed.
datasets.commit_policy: Retrieval-only; use a clearly labeled synthetic fixture for tests.

datasets.provider: New York City Taxi and Limousine Commission
datasets.temporal_coverage: Monthly files; select explicitly at retrieval
transformations: map trip timestamps, distance, fare, and zone IDs
join the official taxi-zone lookup only when spatial polygons are required
limitations: TLC states that it cannot guarantee source accuracy or completeness.
Current downloads are Parquet and require a Parquet-capable batch worker.
No trip-level source data is committed because files are large and license terms are not explicit.

transformations: export a bounded GeoJSON layer for browser visualization
limitations: Small-scale generalized boundaries are unsuitable for cadastral or navigation use.
The platform does not commit the source archive.
